name: Maya Angelou
achievement: Renowned poet and civil rights activist
famous_quote: There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you
short_bio: Maya Angelou was an American poet, memoirist, and civil rights activist who published seven autobiographies and is known for I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings

name: Nelson Mandela
achievement: Anti-apartheid leader and first Black president of South Africa
famous_quote: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world
short_bio: Nelson Mandela was a South African anti-apartheid revolutionary and political leader who served as President of South Africa from 1994 to 1999

name: Barack Obama
famous_quote: Yes we can
short_bio: Barack Obama is an American politician who served as the 44th president of the United States from 2009 to 2017

name: Oprah Winfrey
famous_quote: The biggest adventure you can take is to live the life of your dreams
short_bio: Oprah Winfrey is an American talk show host, television producer, actress, media executive, and philanthropist

name: Bob Marley
famous_quote: One love, one heart, lets get together and feel all right
short_bio: Bob Marley was a Jamaican singer, songwriter, and musician who became an international icon of reggae music and Rastafari

name: Chinua Achebe
famous_quote: If you dont like someones story, write your own
short_bio: Chinua Achebe was a Nigerian novelist, poet, and critic whose first novel Things Fall Apart is widely considered the most important modern African novel

name: Wangari Maathai
achievement: Nobel Peace Prize winner and environmental activist
famous_quote: When we plant trees, we plant the seeds of peace
short_bio: Wangari Maathai was a Kenyan social, environmental and political activist who became the first African woman to win the Nobel Peace Prize

name: Marcus Garvey
achievement: Black nationalist leader and founder of UNIA
famous_quote: A people without the knowledge of their past history is like a tree without roots
short_bio: Marcus Garvey was a Jamaican political activist who founded the Universal Negro Improvement Association and promoted Black nationalism

name: James Baldwin
famous_quote: Not everything that is faced can be changed, but nothing can be changed until it is faced
short_bio: James Baldwin was an American novelist, essayist, playwright, poet, and social critic known for his essays on racial and social issues

name: Martin Luther King Jr
achievement: Leader of the American civil rights movement
famous_quote: I have a dream that one day this nation will rise up
short_bio: Martin Luther King Jr was an American Baptist minister and activist who became the most visible spokesperson of the civil rights movement

name: Mansa Musa
achievement: Richest man in history; expanded Mali Empire and promoted education and Islam
famous_quote: “Wealth is a gift to be shared.”
short_bio: Mansa Musa was the ninth emperor of the Mali Empire, known for his immense wealth, pilgrimage to Mecca, and contributions to education, trade, and Islamic culture.

name: Kofi Annan
achievement: Former UN Secretary-General and Nobel laureate
famous_quote: We may have different religions but we have the same God
short_bio: Kofi Annan was a Ghanaian diplomat who served as the seventh Secretary-General of the United Nations and won the Nobel Peace Prize

name: Josephine Baker
famous_quote: I have two loves my country and Paris
short_bio: Josephine Baker was an American-born French entertainer, French Resistance agent, and civil rights activist

name: Kwame Nkrumah
famous_quote: We face neither East nor West we face forward
short_bio: Kwame Nkrumah was a Ghanaian politician who led Ghana to independence and became the first Prime Minister and President of Ghana

name: Nzinga of Ndongo
famous_quote: I am not afraid of death I am afraid of not living
short_bio: Queen Nzinga was a 17th-century queen of the Ndongo and Matamba kingdoms who fought against Portuguese colonization for over 30 years

name: Haile Selassie
achievement: Emperor of Ethiopia and Rastafarian icon
famous_quote: Education develops the intellect and character
short_bio: Haile Selassie was Emperor of Ethiopia from 1930 to 1974 and is considered the religious symbol for the Rastafari movement

name: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie
famous_quote: We should all be feminists
short_bio: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie is a Nigerian writer whose works include Purple Hibiscus and Americanah and who advocates for feminism and social justice

name: Thomas Sankara
famous_quote: You cannot carry out fundamental change without a certain amount of madness
short_bio: Thomas Sankara was a Burkinabé revolutionary who served as President of Burkina Faso and promoted pan-Africanism and social justice

name: Miriam Makeba
famous_quote: I look at an ant and I see myself a native South African
short_bio: Miriam Makeba was a South African singer and civil rights activist who used her music to speak out against apartheid

name: Patrice Lumumba
achievement: First Prime Minister of independent Congo
famous_quote: The day will come when history will speak but it will not be the history taught in Brussels
short_bio: Patrice Lumumba was a Congolese politician who served as the first Prime Minister of the independent Democratic Republic of the Congo

name: Amilcar Cabral
famous_quote: Hide nothing from the masses of our people
short_bio: Amilcar Cabral was a Bissau-Guinean and Cape Verdean agricultural engineer and revolutionary leader who led the independence movement

name: Fela Kuti
achievement: Creator of Afrobeat and political activist
famous_quote: Music is the weapon of the future
short_bio: Fela Kuti was a Nigerian musician and political activist who created the Afrobeat genre and used his music to criticize military rule

name: Aliko Dangote
famous_quote: To succeed you must have tremendous perseverance
short_bio: Aliko Dangote is a Nigerian business magnate who is the richest person in Africa and founder of the Dangote Group

name: Lupita Nyongo
famous_quote: I hope that my presence on your screens inspires someone
short_bio: Lupita Nyongo is a Kenyan-Mexican actress who won an Academy Award for her role in 12 Years a Slave

name: Desmond Tutu
famous_quote: If you are neutral in situations of injustice you have chosen the side of the oppressor
short_bio: Desmond Tutu was a South African Anglican cleric and theologian who was an outspoken opponent of apartheid

name: Zora Neale Hurston
achievement: Key figure of the Harlem Renaissance
famous_quote: There are years that ask questions and years that answer
short_bio: Zora Neale Hurston was an American author and anthropologist, best known for her novel Their Eyes Were Watching God.

name: W.E.B. Du Bois
famous_quote: The problem of the twentieth century is the problem of the color line.
short_bio: W.E.B. Du Bois was a sociologist, historian, and civil rights activist known for his work on race and sociology in America.
connections: Booker T. Washington, Ida B. Wells

name: Marsha P. Johnson
achievement: Key figure in the Stonewall uprising
famous_quote: No pride for some of us without liberation for all of us.
short_bio: Marsha P. Johnson was a Black transgender activist and drag queen known for her role in the LGBTQ rights movement.

name: Jean-Michel Basquiat
famous_quote: I cross out words so you will see them more.
short_bio: Jean-Michel Basquiat was an American artist known for his graffiti art and contributions to the Neo-expressionism movement.

name: Ida B. Wells
famous_quote: The way to right wrongs is to turn the light of truth upon them.
short_bio: Ida B. Wells was an African American journalist and activist who led an anti-lynching crusade in the United States.
